groups: Primary logical groups 0..2, each with bank_id 0..3; physical owner bit index=group*4+bank_id
identity: One expected pulse_id and owner_epoch plus THREE independent expected generations and bank IDs; supplied by frozen transaction map
admission: One outstanding request. All three mapped banks must already be pending with matching identity. Invalid request is handshaken and rejected; early results require caller retry after pending
ordering: Latch request -> one stats_valid edge for all three -> one publish/discard edge; captures owner's qualified result after stats, including truncation gate
normal_policy: Publish only selected group when selected_valid, range<3, both selected H/V qualified and owner confirms qualified; discard other primary groups. Otherwise discard all three. AUX untouched
replay: want_replay only pins the selected qualified bank in the same owner transition that publishes it; physical RF permission remains separate
runtime_validation: Recheck all pending bits and pulse/epoch/generation before each control edge; quiesce or mismatch suppresses controls and completes with rejected
completion: done/published/published_bank indicate local owner transition, not DMA completion or host delivery; caller associates with its single outstanding request
exclusive_control: No other producer may modify these banks' stats, publish or discard while this adapter owns transaction
remaining: transaction map from qualification engine identity to three bank generations
record header construction and DMA descriptor submission
